difference_explained: VQR-1 (3.0787) and VQR-2B-A (3.0606) used two different WIDTH definitions over the same frozen fit; a third definition exists in production sizing. All three are traced below; ONE canonical definition is now established.

vqr1_record_3_0787.mask_or_contour: original band measurement (nominal body width 343 px)
vqr1_record_3_0787.bounding_box: assembly span 1056 px x nominal body width 343 px
vqr1_record_3_0787.status: HISTORICAL — superseded for policy use by the canonical definition

vqr2b_a_calibration_3_0606.mask_or_contour: dense curve evaluation (per_seg converged 120/240/480: max half-width 172.5125 px)

production_sizing_3_0573.mask_or_contour: max over cubic CONTROL POINTS (172.7 px — control points lie off-curve)
production_sizing_3_0573.status: PRODUCTION SIZING NOTE — conservative 0.11% width undershoot vs canonical; flagged for VQR-2B-B alignment; NOT a proportion-policy basis

raster_fixture_measurement_3_0586.mask_or_contour: background-segmentation mask bbox of the RENDER
raster_fixture_measurement_3_0586.anti_alias_handling: AA edge pixels beyond threshold join the mask
raster_fixture_measurement_3_0586.status: MEASUREMENT-SPACE VARIANT — golden expectation range covers it; never a policy basis

canonical.contour: frozen GLASS cubic component, dense-evaluated at per_seg=240 (converged 120/240/480)
canonical.bounding_box: assembly span 292..1348 px (height) x 2*max GLASS half-width (width), centerline-symmetric
canonical.threshold_policy: not applicable — vector fit, no pixels
canonical.anti_alias_handling: not applicable — vector fit, no raster

ratio_restatement.recorded_1_1244_basis: production control-point sizing vs confirmed 35x95 (historical decision records keep it)
ratio_restatement.classification_unchanged: both exceed the provisional 1.05 — FAIL_REQUIRES_OWNER_DECISION stands
